title: is_databricks_uri must match scheme case-insensitively; only the bare 'databricks' string is a literal fast path
answers: why does DATABRICKS://PROFILE not get detected as a Databricks URI
how to add a fast path to is_databricks_uri without breaking profile URIs
databricks tracking URI detection misses profile or mixed-case URIs
body:
Invariant: is_databricks_uri must still parse the scheme for everything except the exact string "databricks". Profile URIs ("databricks://profile") and uppercase schemes ("DATABRICKS://PROFILE") must return True.
Enforcement: mlflow/utils/uri.py:is_databricks_uri returns `uri == "databricks" or urllib.parse.urlparse(uri).scheme == "databricks"`. urlparse lowercases the scheme, so the parser branch is what handles case.
What breaks if skipped: a string-prefix or lowercase-only shortcut (e.g. uri.startswith("databricks") or a case-sensitive compare) would either misclassify non-Databricks URIs or miss uppercase schemes.
Constraints: the short-circuit is an exact equality check, so it does not cover "databricks:whatever" or "databricks://x"; those still go through urlparse. Keep the short-circuit ordering: the equality check goes first and the parser call second.
Applies: Any change to is_databricks_uri or to the URI-classification helpers in mlflow/utils/uri.py.
applies: Changes to is_databricks_uri or other scheme-detection helpers in mlflow/utils/uri.py.
says: Tracking server connection fails when using uppercase letters in the Databricks scheme.
Databricks workspace profile tracking address is not recognized as a valid connection target.
Allow uppercase and mixed-case schemes when entering the Databricks tracking address.
Connecting to a Databricks tracking server fails when the scheme is capitalized.
Tracking setup should accept capitalized Databricks profile addresses without error.
search: Databricks URI classification in mlflow/utils/uri.py:is_databricks_uri must parse schemes case-insensitively via urllib.parse.urlparse while maintaining an exact-string fast path only for literal databricks. The fast-path equality check must run first, leaving profile URIs like databricks://profile and uppercase schemes like DATABRICKS://PROFILE to urllib.parse.urlparse. Prefix shortcuts or case-sensitive comparisons break uppercase schemes or misclassify non-Databricks URIs. The rule applies to mlflow/utils/uri.py and tests/utils/test_uri.py:test_is_databricks_uri when modifying scheme-detection helpers.
